about: Result-panel thumbnails (about 34 x 47 px) that the installed Poker Hand Tracker saved because it refused them, copied unchanged from %LOCALAPPDATA%/PokerHandTracker/logs/failures (15-17 Oct 2026, builds 202610090631 to 202610171210, the casino table in Chrome). `card` is the card shown, established by looking at every crop on contact sheets (the rank and suit were each checked by eye; the old recogniser's own guess happened to agree for all 215). `at_the_time` is what the recogniser reported when it refused the crop: its best card, and how far the suit beat the other suit of its colour (it needs 0.05). The set is refusals only - it says nothing about thumbnails that were accepted.
